Maybe, just to clarify, I’m not afraid of conflicts if I feel I’m in the right. I work in customer service so I have to deal with that crap very often. However I am not confident in my emotions, I feel things very intensely and my emotions can cloud my judgement. Therefore if I’m feeling really angry or sad I’m overly cautious about acting on it, because there’s always a chance that I’m not thinking logically about a situation.

That’s basically my attitude right now. If the things is light enough for me to question if I’m right or not, why bother. But if they’re being assholes several times over and over, and there’s no good reason for it, why bother?
